result.title: Characterizing Oblivious Common-Reward Multi-Player Bandits: Universal Stationarity, Coordination Traps, and Certified Global Rates
result.comment: 20 pages, including 11 pages of supplementary material
result.summary: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the oblivious common-reward multi-player multi-armed bandit (OC-MPMAB), a minimal multi-player bandit model in which multiple players select arms simultaneously and observe only a shared reward. Crucially, the players are fully oblivious: they do not observe the actions of other players and do not even know whether any other players exist. The contributions of this work are threefold. First, we prove that the independent gradient-bandit updates applied by the players jointly form an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator of a hidden product-policy objective. This property then yields a universal finite-time first-order stationarity guarantee for every instance. Second, we show that stationarity cannot, in general, be strengthened to global optimality. To illustrate this, we identify a product-policy trap obstruction that rules out the guarantee of global optimality. Third, we show that global optimality can be recovered under structural assumptions on the reward table. To make global optimality achievable, we introduce finite-table certificates that separately characterize product-gradient dominance and self-bounding stochastic noise. We then establish certificate-conditioned bounds on the product-policy gap and pseudo-regret. Consequently, the standard $O(1/t)$ product-policy gap and $O(\log T)$ pseudo-regret rates hold when the certificates are uniform.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对 oblivious common-reward 多玩家多臂老虎机做理论研究：证明独立梯度-bandit 更新构成隐藏 product-policy 目标的无偏随机梯度估计，得到普遍的一阶平稳性保证；并给出无法达到全局最优的乘积策略陷阱，以及在奖励表结构假设（有限表证书）下恢复全局最优的 gap 与伪遗憾界。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是多智能体 bandit 的纯理论刻画，不涉及视觉或多模态推理状态、证据获取与停止决策，也未见可供核查的表示或训练线索，故排除。
